text:
sophie: Heads up — NimbusForge (NMB-210) placed account on hold. Invoice INV-2026-518 (due 2026-04-02) is unpaid: $89,640. They claim a daily load test on 2026-03-30 caused ~ $28k spike and are asking for full credit on that portion. They offered a $30k wire today and to dispute the rest.
ben: Any prior chargebacks?
alisha: CX history: none. Last successful payment was 2026-02-14. billing-bot: 2026-04-03 charge attempt failed: CC decline. Auto-usage-anomaly flagged 2026-03-30 (peak +220%).
marta: Sales flags as at-risk but strategic. We should avoid immediate suspension of core infra. Suggest: accept $30k wire, provisional credit up to verified amount, require signed remediation agreement, and throttle heavy endpoints until cleared.
legal-bot: Legal: we can accept provisional credits but include clause that credits are contingent on reconciliation and that acceptance of payment does not waive our rights. Need explicit written acceptance from customer of plan.
sophie: Ops to reconcile telemetry vs customer's logs. If our telemetry shows they triggered the spike via load test on non-prod, we can consider a one-time operational credit up to the disputed $28k. If it's production traffic, deny credit.
alisha: CX can ask for their load test schedule and request screenshots/trace IDs. Add soft reminders at day 3 and day 7.
ben: Finance prefers 40% upfront for accounts >$50k — propose 40% now ($35,856), 30% in 30d, 30% in 60d. If they wire $30k, treat as partial cover of first tranche. Require remittance details and payer name. Wire fees billed back.
marta: Sales: offer to waive one late fee if they sign the plan today. That could speed it.
sophie: Draft message to customer (will paste before sending): "Hi NimbusForge — we received your dispute for INV-2026-518. To avoid interruption while we investigate, please wire $30,000 to the account below and reply with remittance. We will provisionally review telemetry and may apply a credit for verified load-test traffic (final decision within 7 business days). Remaining balance can be placed on a 3-part payment plan (40% now, 30% in 30 days, 30% in 60 days) upon receipt of remittance and signed payment plan. Heavy endpoints will be throttled until first tranche clears. Please confirm acceptance within 5 business days or we will escalate to collections." OK to send?
ben: Approve from Finance contingent on remittance + signed plan.
legal-bot: Approve language; tweak: change "may apply a credit" to "will provisionally apply a credit up to verified amount" and add "this does not constitute a waiver of our rights".
sophie: Noted — will update and send. I will also set automated reminders and flag for add-on throttle on 2026-04-10 if no response. Will paste sent copy here.
alisha: CX on standby to assist once they reply. :pray:
sophie: Sent to ap@nimbusforge.io at 2026-04-04 13:06 UTC — Subject: Action required: INV-2026-518 payment & telemetry reconciliation. Reattempt schedule reopened.
billing-bot: Next automated reattempt scheduled for 2026-04-10.
ben: Thanks team — keep me posted. If they push for net-90, escalate to CFO.
marta: Will do. :handshake:
